summary: This document analyzes the security implications of using IPv6 fragmentation with Neighbor Discovery messages. It updates RFC 4861 to forbid the Fragment Header in all Neighbor Discovery messages, allowing simple countermeasures. It also discusses fragmentation with Secure Neighbor Discovery (SEND) and updates RFC 3971 with advice.

eli5.summary: Cutting neighbor-finding messages into pieces lets attackers sneak in. This says do not cut them up.

questions: are fragments allowed in ipv6 neighbor discovery
